mappings.name: native-resource-contract
mappings.limitation: An explicitly admitted many-to-one observation run; source members remain independent and require exact body/comparison/message correspondence. Shared diagnostics are counted once. Supplemental owners and authored suppression are captured separately.

activation.additionalWarnings: Intentional expansion of the existing enabled rule; measure exact gains and suppressions.

nativeContract.resourceIdentity: Registered ARM resource metadata, native common resource-base ancestry, or explicit custom-resource declaration; neither OpenAPI overrides nor custom emission flags decide identity.
nativeContract.enumeration: Added PUT resource-identity validation exclusively consumes resolveArmResources resource and provider-operation collections; no HTTP-enumeration fallback.
nativeContract.existingCanonicalChecks: Retained independently on their existing complete registration traversal, including LIST/PATCH-only registrations. Resolver-only replacement lost four existing checks; reproduced and reported as Azure/typespec-azure5994 rather than fabricating identities.
nativeContract.diagnostics: Preserve request diagnostics; emit no extra identity diagnostic when canonical response validation already reported that operation. Run identity validation after canonical traversal.
nativeContract.selection: Body-bearing 200 then 201 fallback; explicit void/bodyless responses and response status requirements remain with existing owners.

expensiveGate.question: Determine exact native resource-identity and canonical consistency correspondence for all four original Swagger members after removing the extension-oriented rule.
expensiveGate.estimatedNativeMinutes: 45-90 plus metadata attribution, controls and saved-input recovery
expensiveGate.budget: One final validated candidate checkpoint over all487 frozen projects; no user-imposed ceiling. Preserve failures and incomplete receipts.
expensiveGate.validatorExecution: not-run; immutable production and staging observations reused
